name: Living Room
tagline: Comfortable, welcoming spaces made for real homes
description: Smart, well-built seating and space-saving accents designed for everyday living, easy movement, and relaxed family gatherings.

tips.title: Clear Walkways
tips.description: Leave at least 18-24 inches between your seating and central tables for comfortable legroom and smooth movement in 2BHK layouts.

tips.title: Multi-Purpose Placement
tips.description: Choose versatile folding seating that can be brought out when guests arrive and stowed away during daily family life.

tips.title: Natural Light Anchor
tips.description: Position your primary seating towards natural light or balcony views to maximize daytime brightness.

name: Bedroom
tagline: Calm, uncluttered sanctuaries for restorative rest
description: Practical storage and functional accents proportioned to fit Indian apartment bedrooms without crowding circulation paths.

tips.title: Clear Wall Space
tips.description: Wall-mounted storage keeps floor space open, making compact bedrooms feel twice as large and easier to clean.

tips.title: Corner Utilization
tips.description: Place multi-hook coat and garment stands in unused corners for daily laundry and work bags.

tips.title: Minimalist Visuals
tips.description: Keep daily essentials off surfaces with designated wall hangers to maintain a calm, restful bedroom.

name: Dining & Kitchen
tagline: Flexible dining solutions that adapt to your gathering
description: Foldable, sturdy multipurpose tables and metal folding chairs designed to host family meals without permanently eating into floor space.

tips.title: Flexibility on Demand
tips.description: A folding table lets you host 4 to 6 people for dinner, then folds flat against the wall when you need floor space.

tips.title: Spill & Heat Resistance
tips.description: Durable melamine laminate tops wipe clean instantly with a damp cloth — perfect for hot chai cups and daily Indian curries.

tips.title: Stowaway Chairs
tips.description: Heavy-duty folding chairs can be stored in closet nooks or behind doors between family gatherings.

name: Study & Work
tagline: Focused workspaces built for modern Indian flats
description: Compact folding desks and ergonomic folding chairs that set up in seconds for work-from-home and study routines.

tips.title: Instant Home Office
tips.description: Deploy a 4x2 or 3x2 ft folding table anywhere near a power socket, then fold it away when your workday ends.

tips.title: Ergonomic Height
tips.description: A standard 29.5-inch desktop height paired with supportive seating keeps your posture comfortable during long working hours.

tips.title: Glamping the Clutter
tips.description: Keep laptop chargers, notebooks, and work accessories hung on a nearby coat stand to keep your desk clear.

name: Entryway & Storage
tagline: Smart, clutter-free organization for everyday convenience
description: Wall-mounted metal shoe racks and multi-hook coat stands engineered to keep narrow Indian apartment entryways organized and airy.

tips.title: Zero Floor Footprint
tips.description: Wall mounting your shoe rack lifts footwear off the floor, preventing dust accumulation and simplifying daily sweeping/mopping.

tips.title: Narrow Hallway Friendly
tips.description: Slim fold-down shoe slabs protrude just 15 cm when closed, allowing free passage even in narrow 3-foot apartment hallways.

tips.title: Grab-and-Go Organization
tips.description: Position a multi-hook coat stand right next to the main door for motorcycle helmets, umbrellas, jackets, and grocery bags.

name: Balcony & Utility
tagline: Practical, weather-resistant utility for Indian balconies
description: Rust-resistant powder-coated metal chairs and folding tables that withstand humid weather, morning tea, and evening breezes.

tips.title: Powder-Coated Durability
tips.description: Multi-stage anti-rust phosphating and electro-powder coating protect steel components from monsoon humidity.

tips.title: Fold & Shield
tips.description: During heavy monsoon downpours, simply fold your metal chairs and lean them under balcony awnings or bring them indoors.

tips.title: Breeze & Chai
tips.description: A 3x2 ft folding table turns a narrow 4-foot balcony into a relaxing morning coffee and plant potting nook.
